notes: Register a public client (no secret) in Microsoft Entra ID.
Enable 'Allow public client flows' for PKCE authorization-code.
Add the loopback redirect URI exactly as listed.
Ship the Application (client) ID via the BOBWORK_OAUTH_MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID build environment variable, or configure it once in Bob Work.
Consent screen will then show 'Bob Work' instead of Graph PowerShell / Command Line Tools.
